title: PHYS-HINGE-PUBLIC-01: Qualify public disjoint sphere-hinge components and measured step phases
body:
## Goal and current evidence

Parent #1179; engine family #660. The product target is a reusable renderer-neutral public 3D rigid world. Private numerical HINGE2 and saved-data Viewer results do not complete that target.

Private native `f40123da0eedb19245688557f865e1beb09d47ef` passed the original four-sphere/two-disjoint-hinge fixture for1200 steps/10s in source, repeat and genuine compiled Physics graphs. Recorded Viewer native `9330df8f`, evidence `ba4f0683`, passed independently without Physics calls. Public `createPhysicsWorld` still refuses the original configuration. Original #1279/#1399 failures remain unchanged.

Status: **Public activation NO_GO; issue OPEN.** The INTERNAL saved-phase slice is published at `98955db7d1c8aa85ecadb789d00c6f4916178d04`. The local public candidate `7178434a0440d9dcce0be8c602cf3ba4f8ee5068` is implemented but NOT qualified, merged or published: its sole SOURCE run stopped at step 77 after 76 fully qualified steps on a one-ULP mismatch in both reported joint angles. Later/repeat/compiled/control campaigns remain UNRUN. See the [current result and bounded scalar diagnosis](https://github.com/barocss/barocss/issues/1489#issuecomment-6111755791). Historical runtime provenance or an explicitly reviewed cross-runtime contract study is needed before separately approved resumption. Original exact gates, historical evidence and unrelated holds below remain intact; earlier planning/source-blocker descriptions are the original contract, not a claim that implementation is still unstarted.

## Start conditions

1. Confirm exact f401 native adoption, retained numerical proof and unchanged required providers. Pending Integration screen/file checks alone are not a code blocker.
2. Freeze the public admission, component map, phase order, commands, reports, caps, error precedence, rollback and source/emitted/reference contracts before implementation or trials.
3. Separate the already qualified literal fixture from proposed identifier/order variants. A fresh variant needs its own bounded independent model/phase GO before public support. Do not infer general input support from parser ceilings.
4. Physics owns isolated `packages/barocss-physics/**` and new `examples/physics-public-disjoint-hinge-reference/**`. Integration alone writes develop. No Viewer/GPU/root/lock ownership is transferred.

## First consumer and physical scope

A developer imports the package's public `createPhysicsWorld(config)`, steps two separated dynamic sphere hinge pairs, and reads copied accepted states using the existing public API. There is no private World import, renderer dependency or alternate demonstration factory.

Baseline is the unchanged original HINGE2: dt1/120s; gravity0; radius.1m/mass1kg; identity orientation/zero initial velocity; positions[-.1,0,0],[.1,0,0],[-.1,0,1],[.1,0,1]; restitution0/friction1/.7; local anchors±.1m X; world axis+Z; angle limits±.8rad; motor speed.5rad/s, impulse cap.0001Nms and correction cap.01Nms. SI/RH-Y-up remain. Native baseline IDs/order pairA0,pairB0,pairA1,pairB1 and hinge0,hinge1 remain the immutable reference.

The reusable identity question is explicit: can the same physical components use other valid stable IDs and input order without changing the physical law or accepted meaning? Freeze one rename and one permutation control before numerical calls. Their current status is UNMEASURED. Product support must use body/joint maps and disjointness, not recognize names such as pairA0/hinge0 in solver code. If these controls fail, retain the failed result and do not expose guessed support.

No general translation/rotation, mass/material/gravity variation, connected joint graph, fixed/static/kinematic mixture, additional bodies, CCD, large mode or persistent-box combination is included. Those remain explicit future model contracts. Existing single-pair centred and offset modes and fixed/static branches keep their current admitted input and numerical semantics.

## Source-backed blockers and proposed implementation split

- `joints.ts` rejects dynamic configurations other than one joint/two spheres.
- `dynamic-hinge-joint.ts` offset check assumes absolute Z0; current World checks only the first dynamic hinge.
- Existing public projection occurs inside the8-pass contact loop. Qualified native phases are motor once → free integration once → contact8 → each pair projection once → report once → atomic commit.

Changing admission alone is not adoption of the measured model. Separate component admission/mapping, paired phase execution, state/report copying and qualification harness modules. Reuse qualified mathematics; do not place the entire feature in world.ts or copy the private factory wholesale.

Commands and reports need explicit pre-code treatment for both pairs. The numerical baseline GO is empty commands only. Axis-aligned angular command support needs bounded independent qualification; force/linear/off-axis commands remain refused. Preserve strict caps, unknown thrown identity and known refusal behavior. Per-stage motor/work diagnostics can remain qualification evidence; do not add private observer or force-calibration fields to the public schema without a separate contract.

## Required verification and completion

- Actual owned Physics/CAD builds, strict types, complete consumer/provider source and emitted provenance, real source and genuine public compiled import graphs.
- Original public HINGE2 must admit and complete unchanged1200 steps/10s. Reuse archived independent inputs/certificates as authority where valid; the public graph is new and requires its own actual result.
- Compare named states, geometric angle/anchor/axis/momentum fields and native raw bits under frozen mapping. Distinguish report angle and actual pose, correction impulses and physical forces. Keep first limit197/time1.641666667s distinct from final step1200/time10s.
- Qualify only the selected rename/permutation controls and their deterministic ID/state mapping. Do not claim every valid ID/order, cross-platform replay, dt refinement or admitted commands from unexecuted cases.
- Meaningful old single-pair and fixed/static compatibility controls; complete copied-output ownership, per-pair command refusal, overlapping component refusal, strict-cap rollback, known error preservation, unknown thrown identity, step/time/query/event/dispose behavior. Freeze exact cases/counts before execution.
- No cap/tolerance/physical-law tuning to make a failure pass. Preserve first failures and bounded repairs.
- Exact Integration adoption and native receipts close this bounded card under current owner policy. Record `merged; integration validation pending` for remaining #674/#1254 checks. New public live Viewer usage follows actual API adoption and its own selected contract; saved-data Viewer proof is not that flow.

Full #1179/#660, general engine quality, Box3D parity, performance and release remain OPEN. No product push/PR/deployment/publication is authorized.
